 Hydra       ◌ reading…                                                        
                                                                               
 Agents                                                                        
             ◌ reading…                                                        
                                                                               
 Hydra can run agents on other machines over SSH, for example a build box with 
 more cores or a machine that already has the right toolchain, when a task     
 needs more than this machine offers. Adding a host checks its SSH host key    
 and requirements, installs a matching Hydra there and helps you install and   
 sign in to agents. Nothing changes on the remote until you approve it.        
                                                                               
 Press Enter or A to add a host. Its work then appears in Work beside local    
 heads; L filters by location.                                                 
  ● live                                                                       
 ↑/↓ select • enter open • A add host • / filter • ? help • q quit
